tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Strong maximum principle] 1. ch8:8.19\group ch08-generalized-solutions Assume (8.5), (8.6), and (8.8), and let $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ satisfy $Lu\geq 0$. If some ball $B\Subset \Omega $ satisfies \begin{equation} \sup _Bu=\sup _\Omega u\geq 0, \tag {8.62} \end{equation} then $u$ is constant in $\Omega $. If this constant is nonzero, equality holds in (8.8).
Proof

\sketch On a concentric ball compactly contained in $\Omega $, apply Theorem 8.18 with $p=1$ to the nonnegative supersolution $M-u$, where $M=\sup _\Omega u$. Its infimum vanishes, so $u=M$ on a larger ball. Propagate this equality through the connected domain. Substitution of a nonzero constant gives equality in (8.8).

□
